vocabulary.meaning_en: the tense for finished actions at a specific time: I read it yesterday
vocabulary.example: I ate dinner at five o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: have/has + past participle: a past action with an effect now, no specific time

vocabulary.example: The simple past shows a completed action.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a result or change caused by something
vocabulary.example: A past action can have an effect now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of writing in a newspaper or website
vocabulary.example: I read an interesting article yesterday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: at some time in the past (not specific)

vocabulary.example: How long have you lived here?
How many times have you visited Cairo?

fine_lines.title: I read it yesterday vs I've read it
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط مع وقت محدد (yesterday, at five, two hours ago). المضارع التام بدون وقت محدد: حدث في الماضي وله أثر الآن. لا نقول I've read it yesterday.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Simple past with a specific time (yesterday, at five, two hours ago). Present perfect with no specific time: it happened in the past and matters now. Don't say "I've read it yesterday".

fine_lines.title: When? vs How long? / How many times?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: When? يحتاج وقتًا محددًا → الماضي البسيط. How long? و How many times? → المضارع التام.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "When?" needs a specific time → simple past. "How long?" and "How many times?" → present perfect.

examples.sentence: When did you see him? I saw him two hours ago.
How many times have you read it? I've read it three times.

expressions.meaning_en: I read it at some time in the past.
expressions.example: This story sounds familiar. I've read this before.
Have I read this before? I'm not sure.

grammar.title: Simple past: specific time or completed action
grammar.explanation_ar: نستعمل الماضي البسيط لحدث في وقت محدد في الماضي، أو لحدث انتهى. حيلة: S = Simple = Specific.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the simple past for an action at a specific past time, or a completed action. Trick: S = Simple = Specific.
examples: I saw the man two hours ago.
I ate dinner at five o'clock.

grammar.title: Present perfect: past with an effect now, no specific time
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع التام (have/has + التصريف الثالث) لحدث في الماضي له أثر الآن، ولا نذكر وقتًا محددًا. لا نستعمل معه yesterday أو ago.
grammar.explanation_en: The present perfect (have/has + past participle) is for a past action that matters now, with no specific time. Don't use it with "yesterday" or "ago".

grammar.title: Simple rule
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع التام: كم من الوقت (how long) أو كم مرة (how many times). الماضي البسيط: متى بالتحديد (when).
grammar.explanation_en: Present perfect: how long or how many times. Simple past: exactly when.
examples: I've lived here for five years. (how long)
I've been to Paris twice. (how many times)

questions.question: Which sentence is wrong?
questions.explanation_ar: لا نستعمل المضارع التام مع yesterday.
questions.explanation_en: Don't use the present perfect with "yesterday".

questions.question: "How many times ___ this film?"
questions.explanation_ar: how many times مع المضارع التام.
questions.explanation_en: "How many times" with the present perfect.

questions.question: The simple past is used for ___.
questions.explanation_en: Simple past is for a specific time.

questions.question: "I ___ here for five years." (and I still live here)
The present perfect shows ___.
choices: a past action with an effect now
questions.explanation_en: A past action that matters now.
